what_we_believe_today: Food and beer designed together is a stronger concept than either alone; untested.
evidence_that_would_change_direction: Blind or paired sessions show no lift, or guests value the food alone and treat beer as incidental.
direction_it_would_change_to: Lead with food; treat beer as supporting or partner-supplied.
cheapest_way_to_find_out: Pairing session with and without matched drinks (H3).
who_decides: Founder, informed by guest scores and advisors

what_we_believe_today: Austin is the right first city; supported by a small desk sample only.
evidence_that_would_change_direction: Interviews and sales show too small or saturated a niche, or a better-fit city shows clearer demand or access.
direction_it_would_change_to: Test in another city or narrow the Austin niche.

what_we_believe_today: Five dishes are a workable development core; not a final menu.
evidence_that_would_change_direction: A dish fails its frozen gates, is gimmicky to blind tasters, or cannot be sourced to D-54.
direction_it_would_change_to: Rework or replace the weakest dish; the five is not sacred.
cheapest_way_to_find_out: Cook the sessions and apply the gates.

what_we_believe_today: D-77 is an agent proposal awaiting founder confirmation: Hefeweizen as proof beer; unconfirmed.
evidence_that_would_change_direction: A brewer finds the style a poor proof, or guests prefer another style for reliability and repeat drinking.
direction_it_would_change_to: Choose another proof beer or use several proofs.
cheapest_way_to_find_out: Brewer review of the six proofs.

what_we_believe_today: A house brewery is the long-run goal, last in the capital order.
evidence_that_would_change_direction: Guests value partner beer equally; collaboration teaches enough; brewery capex is out of proportion to sales.
direction_it_would_change_to: Partner or contract beer, or a smaller brew system.

what_we_believe_today: A concept form, not locked; brewhouse at the centre of a courtyard.
evidence_that_would_change_direction: An architect or brewer finds it impractical for the site, drainage, cost or operations.
direction_it_would_change_to: A conventional layout or another planning form.
cheapest_way_to_find_out: Architect and brewer review on a candidate site.
who_decides: Architect and brewer advise; founder decides

what_we_believe_today: Each plate has a chosen drink; the logic is a design hypothesis.
evidence_that_would_change_direction: Guests ignore the pairing, find it preachy, or choose their own drink with no loss of satisfaction.
direction_it_would_change_to: Lighter suggestions, or a menu without fixed pairings.
cheapest_way_to_find_out: Observe orders when pairings are offered or not.

what_we_believe_today: Non-alcoholic pairings deserve equal standing with beer.
evidence_that_would_change_direction: NA drinks prove weaker in tasting, or guests do not order them even with equal billing.
direction_it_would_change_to: Keep equal respect in design but adjust depth of the NA program.
cheapest_way_to_find_out: Blind-compare NA pairings with the dishes.

what_we_believe_today: The experience can justify a premium; no price is known.
evidence_that_would_change_direction: Accepted prices do not cover cost per portion, or guests judge the experience ordinary against nearby options.
direction_it_would_change_to: Reposition as casual or reduce the offer.
